heading: ADDENDUM <Act No. 12504, Mar. 24, 2014>
text: This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That the amended provisions of Articles 24-2 and 75 (2) 5 of the Personal Information Protection Act (Act No. 11990) shall enter into force on January 1, 2016.

heading: ADDENDUM <Act No. 14765, Apr. 18, 2017>
text: This Act shall enter into force six months after the date of its promulgation.
